The incident resulted in injuries to Ranganath Pandey, Vishwambhar Nath Chaurasia, and Meeta Sonkar, who were walking along the roadside.  The police have registered a case and are reviewing CCTV footage and eyewitness statements to determine the cause of the crash.

recent_articles.title: Woman, child die in Kuttiyadi as heavy rain batters Kozhikode - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Remya**, a 36-year-old pharmacist, and her seven-year-old son **Sivanand** tragically drowned in Kuttiyadi, Kerala, after being swept away by strong currents from the river.  The incident occurred as heavy rain continued to batter the district. The tragedy happened when **Sivanand** slipped into the water while **Remya** was washing clothes on the riverbank.
